question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'An expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of death'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Condolence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Condolence"** refers to an expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of someone's death. (शोक संवेदना)

 

 
• **Example:** She sent her condolences to the family of the deceased after hearing the tragic news.

 

 

 
• **"Consolation"** means the comfort received by a person after a loss or disappointment. (सांत्वना)

 

 
• **Example:** His kind words brought her consolation during her time of grief.

 

 

 
• Hence, the correct word for "An expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of death" is **"Condolence"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Condolence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Consolation **(सांत्वना): Comfort received after a loss or disappointment.

 

 
• **Example:** The player's teammates offered him words of consolation after the game was lost.

 

 

 
• **Reassurance **(आश्वासन): The action of removing someone's doubts or fears.

 

 
• **Example:** The teacher gave the students reassurance before the exam, saying they had prepared well.

 

 

 
• **Assurance **(भरोसा): A positive declaration intended to give confidence.

 

 
• **Example:** She gave her assurance that the project would be completed on time.

 

 

52:T63e,

The correct answer is **option 1.**
